intended_behavior_phases: Phase 1: Stabilize and descend toward pad using main engine and orientation control.
Phase 2: Fine-tune horizontal position and vertical velocity near pad.
Phase 3: Soft landing with both legs contacting pad, minimal residual velocity.

component_scale_reasoning.objective_success_bonus: Large positive reward (+100) for achieving both legs contact near pad with low velocity, to make success clearly distinguishable.
component_scale_reasoning.progress_shaping: Moderate negative reward for distance from pad (-1 * distance) and vertical speed (-0.3 * |vy|) to guide descent; these are reachable and provide continuous feedback.
component_scale_reasoning.regularizers: Mild penalties for fuel use (-0.03 * m_power, -0.02 * s_power) to encourage efficiency without discouraging necessary engine use; small penalty for angle deviation (-0.05 * |angle|) to promote upright posture.
component_scale_reasoning.crash_penalty: Large negative reward (-100) for crashes to strongly discourage failure.
component_scale_reasoning.diagnostics: Include distance, vertical speed, leg contact, angle, angular velocity, fuel usage, and crash indicator for monitoring.

component_interaction_check: The success bonus dominates when landing is achieved; progress shaping ensures the agent moves toward the pad; regularizers are mild enough not to overpower the shaping; crash penalty is high to avoid dangerous behavior.
